title: Deeper/broader open-source ACIS route and InventorLoader qualification refresh
scope: Cross-check the open-source OCCT data-exchange boundary against its commercial component catalog.
Refresh provenance, DXF handoff, parser/kernel lineage, and licensing information for the already-known InventorLoader candidate.
Narrow the security finding for the current Law.evaluate eval primitive to confirmed code facts and unconfirmed reachability.
Update the existing composed qualification sub-plan without adding dependencies, fixtures, tests, or support claims.

method.evidenceRule: Mutable source and project documentation establish declared route and current visible provenance only. No semantic, native, security, or local-defect claim is established without pinned execution or a local reproducer.

evidence.topic: OCCT open-source core versus commercial exchange modules
evidence.observed: The OCCT wiki lists standard exchange formats including STEP, IGES, glTF, OBJ, VRML and STL, and classifies ACIS SAT and DXF under advanced exchange components. The OCCT-Components repository describes itself as a public preview/documentation hub for commercial extensions and directs users to its store for full components.
doesNotEstablish: The installed components or entitlements of a particular FreeCAD or OCCT binary
Availability of a free/open-source general SAT/SAB or DXF semantic reader in stock OCCT
Exact profile acceptance, DWG AcDs extraction, or native platform qualification
evidence.planUse: Do not infer an ACIS reader from a FreeCAD/OCCT dependency. Keep licensed OCCT exchange optional and outside the default build and per-slice loop.

evidence.observed: The current package.xml identifies InventorLoader 1.5.1 dated 2024-12-12 and declares LGPL-3.0-or-later, while the repository LICENSE contains GPL-2 license text. The visible master history ends with commit e94bdf5e29052a0dc7ce6fdf755e956ae507caec dated 2024-12-17, and GitHub currently lists no formal release entry. The discrepancy is unresolved.
doesNotEstablish: A verified release artifact matching the current mutable master tree
Resolution of package metadata versus repository license text
Compatibility with a current FreeCAD/Python ABI or a reproducible runtime
evidence.planUse: Require exact source and artifact pins. Resolve license provenance before copying, bundling, or redistributing code; do not use a mutable branch or README version label as an artifact identity.

evidence.observed: The wrapper uses ezdxf.readfile, extracts per-entity sat/sab payloads, and sends them to the add-on's AcisReader. Geometry construction uses FreeCAD Part. Existing source review found shell/face/wire construction paths, not proof of a complete closed solid. This is a separate inner-parser path but shares FreeCAD/OCCT kernel lineage, relies on ezdxf for the outer DXF, lacks a demonstrated source identity/owner/block/placement crosswalk, and does not parse DWG AcDs.
doesNotEstablish: DXF entity ownership or placement completeness
DWG/AcDs reader support or source-key-payload association
Closed-solid validity or complete semantic conversion
evidence.planUse: Retain only as an optional composed-checkpoint parser/consumer route with an external identity and payload-hash sidecar, full per-body disposition, and independent analytic geometry expectations.

evidence.observed: Acis.py defines Law.evaluate using eval(self.eq), and readLaw can produce a Law wrapper from text. Web source search found no evaluate() call in the reviewed Acis.py or Acis2Step.py surfaces. The whole repository call graph and file-data reachability were not audited.
doesNotEstablish: Unreachability through all importer, plugin, or downstream paths
evidence.planUse: Describe eval as a present primitive with unresolved reachability, not as a confirmed exploit. Before untrusted payload use, inspect all pinned source call sites/data flow and resource limits; if reachable, restrict evaluation or keep the candidate isolated and diagnostic-only.

limitations: GitHub source and catalog pages are mutable; the current branch state was not cloned or cryptographically verified locally.
The package metadata and repository license text disagree; this review does not provide a legal resolution.
The Law.evaluate call graph was checked only in selected source surfaces; no complete source-wide taint/resource audit or runtime test occurred.
No InventorLoader, OCCT component, FreeCAD build, or external CAD/kernel was installed or executed.
No new route closes the DWG AcDs association, independent semantic evidence, or native Linux/Windows qualification gates.
